title: Development and internal validation of a predictive model for COVID-19 mass screening based on symptoms and a simple olfactory test
summary: A classification tree combines symptoms and an olfactory test in a prospective 519-person COVID-19 cohort, with PCR reference results; sensitivity is high but specificity is only 0.39, limiting its screening interpretation.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: In a prospective 519-person cohort, the classification tree combined symptoms and olfactory-test results against PCR; reported specificity was 0.39 despite high sensitivity.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Combines symptoms and an olfactory test in a classification tree to predict COVID-19 status against PCR.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
